change_summary: Keep one source-to-Work-Model semantic owner and expose the exact Project-node identity accepted by organization so external Hosts do not duplicate work or guess IDs.

canonical_skill.note: The Skill makes one organization Mission authoritative for a newly retained source set and states the typed Project-node boundary.

server_contract.note: The shared contract advances with structured post-finalize routing plus complete fetch metadata and organization-target guidance.

package_manifests.note: Plugin and Skill manifests advance together to 1.7.36 with collaboration contract 2026-09-13.11.

workspace_cli.note: Workspace/Admin CLI 0.1.0-beta.30 exposes the optional Project-only organization target and the single-owner boundary.

help_center.note: Public guidance distinguishes one organization owner from bounded Ask work and forbids Page/document UUID substitution for a Project node target.

package_setup.note: OAuth, MCP endpoint and package installation steps are unchanged.

harness_and_mainline.note: The Host Harness rejects overlapping Ask and organization owners for the same Asset identity in one user turn.

external_marketplaces.note: The official package publication is first-party; external directory review and full independent Claude longitudinal acceptance remain separate evidence.

release_evidence.note: Focused tests cover duplicate-owner rejection, structured finalize routing, fetch node/type metadata, Project-only target guidance and public distribution parity.
